rationale: The long momentum thesis has weakened: price has fallen below the 5-minute 9-EMA and the bid is under session VWAP, with consecutive lower 1-minute closes and a new low since entry. Although the hard invalidation at $173.30 has not triggered, the setup no longer meets the original entry conditions and the wide spread raises wait-and-see slippage risk. There is no strong enough reversal evidence to flip short against a high-relative-volume gap-up and positive market regime.
